LanguageData.Hediff_GelatinizationTemporary.label: Semi-gelatinization in Progress
LanguageData.Hediff_GelatinizationTemporary.descripti: A limb is undergoing semi-gelatinization. Adaptation and severity race each other: if adaptation reaches 100% first, the limb becomes a gelatinized prosthetic; if severity reaches 100% first, the limb is destroyed.
LanguageData.Hediff_GelatinizedArm.label: Gelatinized Arm
LanguageData.Hediff_GelatinizedArm.description: The arm has been modified into a semi-gelatinized prosthetic, granting additional strength and flexibility.
LanguageData.Hediff_GelatinizedLeg.label: Gelatinized Leg
LanguageData.Hediff_GelatinizedLeg.description: The leg has been modified into a semi-gelatinized prosthetic, granting additional move speed and defense.
LanguageData.SSC_FullGelatinizationTemporary.label: Full Gelatinization in Progress
LanguageData.SSC_FullGelatinizationTemporary.descript: The whole body is undergoing gelatinized restructuring. Adaptation and severity keep racing each other: if adaptation reaches 100% first, full completion is achieved; if severity reaches 100% first, the body collapses outright.
LanguageData.SSC_FullGelatinizedBody.label: Full Gelatinization Complete
LanguageData.SSC_FullGelatinizedBody.description: This body has completed full gelatinized restructuring. Aside from RJW organ states, prior physical damage is washed away, leaving only a stabilized gelatinized form.
LanguageData.SSC_FullGelatinizedBody.stages.0.label: Gel Shell
